title: Word Ladder
summary: Find the length of the shortest chain of words from a start word to a target, changing one letter at a time.

tests.explain: One shortest sequence is cold → cord → card → ward → warm: 5 words. Other routes (through word and worm) are no shorter.
"tock" is not in the word list, so no sequence can end with it: 0.
"ab" → "ac" changes one letter, so the sequence has 2 words.

hints: Words are nodes; two words are joined by an edge when they differ in exactly one position. The question asks for the fewest edges, so think BFS.
Don't build the whole graph. From a word, try every position and every letter a–z, and keep the candidates that are in a Set of unused dictionary words.
Delete a word from the Set when you enqueue it, so it is never queued twice. Count levels: the start word is level 1, and return the level at which you reach endWord (0 if you never do).

complexity.time: O(N · L² · 26): N words, each tries 26·L candidates and building one costs O(L)
complexity.space: O(N · L): the Set and the queue of words
